questions.question: What was found during the repair of the temple under Josiah?
options: A sealed treaty made with the kings of old
The Book of the Law of the LORD given through Moses
A great store of gold hidden away deep beneath the altar
An ancient scroll of the psalms of David
questions.answer: The Book of the Law of the LORD given through Moses
